people.name: David
people.line: Anointed king of Israel, ancestor of Jesus Christ

people.name: Horesh
people.line: A wilderness area where David hid from Saul

people.name: Jonathan
people.line: Eldest son of King Saul and friend of David

translations.web: They both made a covenant before Yahweh. Then David stayed in the woods, and Jonathan went to his house.
translations.bsb: So the two of them made a covenant before the LORD. And David remained in Horesh, while Jonathan went home.
translations.kjv: And they two made a covenant before the LORD: and David abode in the wood, and Jonathan went to his house.
translations.asv: And they two made a covenant before Jehovah: and David abode in the wood, and Jonathan went to his house.
